steps.title: Branch, plan, Transport trait + SyncError
steps.summary: Branched phase-05-sync from phase-04-relay (merged as 54c863b). core/src/sync/ module directory created. transport.rs: Transport trait (push/pull/put_head), SyncError (12 variants), VaultOps, NO_HEAD sentinel.

steps.title: MemoryTransport + inject_raw_op
steps.summary: memory.rs: MemoryTransport with BTreeMap ops store, inject_raw_op (insert+update for tamper tests), set_raw_head, truncate_ops. 5 unit tests.

steps.title: FolderTransport (atomic writes, conflicted-copy tolerance)
steps.summary: folder.rs: non-wasm file-based transport. Ops stored as CBOR files; head as a JSON file. Atomic writes via temp-file + rename. Conflicted copies tolerated. 3 unit tests.

steps.title: SyncEngine + VaultSyncState
steps.summary: engine.rs: SyncEngine::sync() — pull → verify → merge into DAG → check_head_update → push pending → put_head. VaultSyncState holds the local DAG, pending queue and pinned head. Offline-first: enqueue works before any sync. 4 unit tests.

steps.title: HttpRelayTransport (reqwest blocking, rustls-tls)
steps.summary: http.rs: non-wasm HTTP transport. JSON + CBOR over the relay's /v1/vaults/:id/ops and /v1/vaults/:id/head routes. No unit tests (integration deferred to Phase 6). D-0501 records the crate set.

steps.title: Test-harness fixture + EvilRelay (14 attack variants)
steps.summary: test-harness/src/fixture.rs: two-device Fixture (make_op, genesis, engine, state1/2, two_op_history, loaded_dag). test-harness/src/evil_relay.rs: EvilRelay wrapping MemoryTransport with 14 Attack variants and head-snapshot machinery.

steps.title: 14 evil-relay attack tests + 3 multi-device simulation tests
steps.summary: tests/evil_relay_tests.rs: evil_relay_rollback_is_detected, evil_relay_ghost_head_entry_is_detected, evil_relay_reordered_ops_cause_missing_parent, evil_relay_stripped_signature_is_detected, evil_relay_flipped_bit_is_detected, evil_relay_substitute_device_cert_is_detected, evil_relay_downgrade_suite_is_detected, evil_relay_truncate_ops_is_detected, evil_relay_replay_old_op_is_harmless, evil_relay_honest_passthrough_succeeds, evil_relay_swapped_ciphertext_is_detected, plus two_device_concurrent_edits_converge, three_device_concurrent_edits_converge, offline_device_catches_up. All 14 pass.

steps.title: evil_relay_show example, D-0501, THREAT_MODEL §19, PROGRESS, status.json
steps.summary: examples/evil_relay_show.rs: coloured terminal table running all 13 attack variants. docs/DECISIONS.md D-0501. docs/THREAT_MODEL.md §19: 14 vectors, named tests, R-0501..R-0503. docs/PROGRESS.md Phase 5 entry. status.json updated to Phase 5.

steps.title: cargo deny check, commit, push, PR #48

risks.title: R-0001 — CodeQL code scanning skipped while the repository is private (issue #23)
R-0401 — No email notification on account lockout; rate limit enforced, notification is Phase 8 (issue #43)
R-0403 — Malicious relay operator can delete OPAQUE credential; mitigation in Phase 13 (issue #44)
R-0404 — Malicious relay can serve forged identity key; mitigation in Phase 11 key transparency (issue #45)
R-0405 — crypto-bigint 0.5.5 timing side-channel (RUSTSEC-2026-0387) via opaque-ke; ristretto255 hot paths use curve25519-dalek not crypto-bigint (D-0402); excepted in deny.toml (issue #46)
R-0501 — A malicious relay that withholds ops indefinitely can delay convergence; pull-proof mechanism deferred to Phase 13
R-0502 — FolderTransport conflicted-copy files accumulate on disk if two writers collide; accepted (no production use until Phase 9)
R-0503 — HttpRelayTransport does not retry on transient network errors; accepted (offline-first design handles this)
